repo_notes.content: SCOPE — what this repository is and is not. The product is Salon1cAPI, an unofficial Swift client for the 1С:SPA-Салон API (редакция 3.0) hosted at cloud.salon1c.ru, generated with Apple's swift-openapi-generator and exposed as-is so that every request the API accepts remains expressible. It is not a 1С product and is not affiliated with 1С. The decisive fact about this repository is that the vendor publishes no OpenAPI document — only an API Blueprint on Apiary — so Sources/Salon1cAPI/openapi.yaml was written by hand against Upstream/salon1c/salon1c.apib. That file is simultaneously the package's greatest asset and its largest liability, and the wiki should say so. Do not present the generated types as a hand-authored API surface, and do not present the specification as vendor-supplied. Several root-level Markdown files are process artefacts, not product documentation: CLAUDE.md is agent instructions and REVIEW.md steers automated PR review.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: AUTHORITATIVE SOURCES, in precedence order. The DocC catalogue at Sources/Salon1cAPI/Salon1cAPI.docc/ is authoritative for architecture and direction; where it and README.md disagree the catalogue wins. Design.md holds every load-bearing decision with the alternative that was rejected. SpecOwnership.md explains why openapi.yaml is hand-written and what that obligates, and is the article a reader should reach first. WorkingWithSalon1c.md records documented quirks of the API — including the two response-envelope dialects ({parameters, errors} vs {Parameters, Errors, Meta}) and the in-body domain error catalogue 1000–1114 — plus dated wire observations as they arrive. TechDebt.md lists every compromise carried, what it costs and what would retire it. Roadmap.md is the planned work in priority order. Upstream/salon1c/ holds the vendor's API Blueprint verbatim with its internal-defect list.
repo_notes.author: maintainer

repo_notes.content: CONSUMER CONSTRAINTS that any useful page set must convey. The package requires Swift 6.2 or newer and iOS 17 / macOS 14 / tvOS 17 / watchOS 10 / visionOS 1. Requests go over URLSession through Apple's Swift OpenAPI URLSession transport, and generated code is produced by the build plugin and never committed. Authentication is two header credentials — apikey on every request, usertoken on client-scoped operations — carried by Credentials/AuthMiddleware, not by generated code. The default server is the documented http://cloud.salon1c.ru/api, but per-salon on-premises deployments exist, so Client.init(serverURL:) is a first-class escape hatch rather than a test hook. Because the specification is owned here rather than upstream, any correction to it moves the generated surface: the relationship between openapi.yaml, the generator configuration and the published API is the spine of this package and should be documented as such.
